summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by ICICI Bank Limited reporting the outcome of its Board meeting held on April 18, 2026. The Board recommended a dividend of ₹12 per equity share, approved audited financial results for Q4 and FY2026, authorized annual renewal of debt fund-raising limits (₹250 billion domestically and USD 1.5 billion overseas), and extended the tenure of the Group Chief Risk Officer. No special situation such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change is present. This is an ordinary current report on financial results and routine corporate approvals.
